Unfortunately, the full text of *Glassy-eyed* by Ama Owusu is not available for retrieval. It can only be accessed through an institutional subscription to a library service, and currently, only a preview of Chapter 1 is accessible. This limitation means that I cannot provide you the entire text you need to prepare your review.

If you are affiliated with an educational or public institution, I recommend checking if they provide access to the book through their library services. You can also explore platforms like Amazon or other eBook retailers where the book might be available for purchase.

I understand the urgency of your deadline, and I recommend reaching out to your literary journal or editor to explain the situation regarding your review copy. They may provide guidance or an extension if needed.
